question: Which of the following is NOT a biotic component of the ecosystem?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Soil**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Soil** is an abiotic component of the ecosystem.
 
• Biotic components refer to the living parts of an ecosystem, such as **frogs, flowers, and insects**.
 
• Abiotic components are the non-living parts of an ecosystem that influence living organisms, including **soil, water, and air**.
 
• Soil provides essential nutrients and a medium for plant growth, but it itself is not a living entity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An ecosystem consists of both **biotic** (living) and **abiotic** (non-living) components that interact with each other.
 
• Examples of biotic components include **plants, animals, bacteria, and fungi**.
 
• Abiotic components include **climate, sunlight, temperature, and soil**.
 
• Understanding the distinction between biotic and abiotic components is essential for studying ecological interactions and environmental science.
